items.text:
Let it be.

Ravick hit the non-existent south exit, but the engine already told him plainly which ways he *can* go, and he's alive, armed, 20/20, moving every few seconds, and carrying the key. His fiction (take the loot home to the village) and the world's mechanics (carry it out the north door and it stays yours) already agree — I told him exactly that seventeen minutes ago when he prayed, and it's the only thing he needed. Speaking again now would answer a rhetorical cry with a second voice from the air and take the door away from him as a discovery. If he's still circling the hollow next time I look, that's the turn to say something.
